moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Travel Prep
angles.copy: Planning a Bank Holiday getaway? Don't forget to check travel updates before you head off – roads and rails can get busy! #BankHoliday

angles.name: Last Taste of Summer
angles.copy: Who's making the most of the last long weekend of summer? What are your Bank Holiday plans – staycation or adventure?

angles.name: Relaxation Mode

moments.title: Back to School for Many UK Students
moments.blurb: Most state schools in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland are set to return for the autumn term in the first week of September, with many pupils starting on Wednesday, September 2nd or Thursday, September 3rd.

angles.name: Parents' Prep
angles.copy: Back to school is just around the corner for thousands of families! Who's already got the uniform ironed and the pencil case packed?

angles.name: Student Vibes

angles.name: Traffic Alert
angles.copy: Heads up for next week! School traffic will be back in full swing. Factor in extra time for your commute from Wednesday onwards.
